Ten wins. The Buyer tips his hat.
Яд бьёт мимо блока и не слабеет. Ты не п: Poison ignores block and never weakens. You don't break armor — you go around it.
The cloud, the hive and spores in sockets build up poison. The molotov ignites it: three poisons burn into a “Gas flash”.
Ожог тикает сам, а огнемёт бьёт сильнее: Burn ticks on its own, and the flamethrower hits harder for every burn on the enemy.
Уголёк в гнезде даёт разгон за каждое по: An ember in a socket gives haste for every hit: the longer it burns, the faster you shoot.
Ты не бьёшь — бьются об тебя. Блок растё: You don't hit — they hit you. Block grows, thorns return damage, shields hit with your own block.
Rivets in armor sockets multiply block. The spiked shield and the boomerang shield turn it into damage.
Одна винтовка, все модули в неё. Стреляе: One rifle, every mod in it. It fires rarely, but a crit takes a third of the health.
Прицел и молния в гнёздах поднимают крит: A scope and lightning in sockets raise crit, the detonator raises its multiplier. The rest of the space goes to surviving until the shot.
Оружия почти нет: за тебя дерётся стая,: Almost no weapons: a pack fights for you, and it grows right in battle.
Каждый призыв бьёт сам. Некромант и навы: Every summon hits on its own. The necromancer and skills raise everyone's damage; mods don't work on summons — they need auras.
Автоматика стреляет очередями, а эхо пов: Automatics fire in bursts, and the echo repeats every shot. Small damage — a hundred shots.
Пружины в гнёздах и разгон сокращают пау: Springs in sockets and haste cut the pauses; the battery and the conductor give a chance to fire again. Watch your stamina.
Кости, карты и рулетка. Удача превращает: Dice, cards and roulette. Luck turns misses into crits and wins into gold.
Каждая единица удачи — это +4% меткости: Each luck stack is +4% accuracy and +3% crit. Stack enough and sixes stop being chance.
Оружие пьёт твоё здоровье и возвращает б: Weapons drink your health and give back more than they take. The worse you feel, the harder you hit.
Капля крови в гнезде даёт +2 урона ценой: A drop of blood in a socket gives +2 damage for 1 health per hit; lifesteal and the chalice pay it back. Cursed blades grow with every win.
Инструменты почти не ранят. Зато каждая: Instruments barely hurt. But every note is a buff, and each of their hits charges the main battery.
Тяжёлое оружие копит +2 урона за каждое: Heavy weapons store +2 damage for each hit of your other weapons and spend it all in one volley. The lute and the drum beat often.
Серия: каждое попадание подряд даёт +1 у: Streak: each hit in a row gives +1 damage, up to +5. Four pairs of fists — and by second three each hits six times harder.
Меткость важнее урона: промах сбрасывает: Accuracy matters more than damage: a miss resets the streak. Dodge from the headband and the cloak saves health while the streak grows.
Сначала намочи, потом ударь током: мокры: Soak first, then shock: a wet enemy takes 1.5× more, and ice stuns them.
Пузырьки вешают сырость. Гроза по мокром: Bubbles apply wet. Storm on wet is “Conductor”, ice on wet is “Icicle”, a pierce on a frozen enemy is “Shatter”.
Первые раунды ты выживаешь. С шестого на: The first rounds you survive. From round six the shop starts showing late items — and the battle is decided by things that grow every second.
Меч тысячи истин прибавляет +2 урона каж: The sword of a thousand truths adds +2 damage every 3 s, the tree heals, the throne freezes. The stone of eternity and the AI chip are inserts for its three sockets.
Это твой рюкзак. Всё, что лежит на сумка: This is your backpack. Everything lying on the bags fights by itself. Build it stronger than your rivals'.
Прилавок Скупщика. Перетащи товар на рюк: The Buyer's stall. Drag goods onto the backpack to buy them. To sell a piece you don't need, drop it on the stall.
Предмет работает, только когда целиком л: An item only works when it lies fully on bags. Bags are sold too: more bags, more room.
Чтобы повернуть предмет, нажми на него и: To rotate an item, tap it and choose “Rotate”. On a computer, press R while holding the item.
Запас: сюда кладут то, что пока не нужно: The stash: put what you don't need yet here. Things are kept here but don't fight.
Некоторые детали срастаются в новый пред: Some pieces fuse into a new item when they touch. Every piece's tooltip shows its recipe — tap it.
Сверху жизни и победы. 10 побед — забег: Lives and wins are at the top. 10 wins and the run is won; run out of lives and it's lost.
Готов? Жми «В бой». Бой идёт сам, а ты с: Ready? Press “Fight”. The battle plays itself while you watch your build work.
Здоровье. Кончится — бой проигран. Базов: Health. When it runs out, the battle is lost. Base health grows every round for both sides equally, while health items add it only to you.
Выносливость. Оружие тратит её на каждый: Stamina. Weapons spend it on every hit and wait while it recovers. Too many heavy weapons will sit idle.
Оружие бьёт само, когда заполнится его п: Weapons strike by themselves when their bar fills. Armor and shields give block: it takes damage before health does.
